properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL (Anthony, 2026-10-27, thinking out loud): "While reflow2 can 'design anything', it is clear that it'll do a lot of designing software. Also, now that we have flo2-calc, should we consider adding Big O notation to designing software? Should we include Big O in software programming designs?"

Options as they came up (none chosen):
(a) DECLARED: a capability or component states its growth in the design ("loop_status is O(n) in nodes; draw_edges is O(k) in its items"), as a quality target beside it. Cheapest: a property and a habit, no new machinery.
(b) MEASURED: a check runs the part at three or more sizes, counts operations (or reads, or bytes of reply) rather than timing it, fits the growth, and passes only if the fit is within the declared class. reflow2 already did this once by hand: granularity was brought to N+2 store reads "guarded by a COUNT at three sizes ... never by a timer" (chg:granularity-optimised-against-a-written-budget). Medium: a verification pattern plus a skill step, reusing the optimize skill.
(c) BUDGET AT THE SIZE THAT MATTERS: instead of a class, a number at the design's expected size ("at 5,600 nodes, loop_status answers in 2 s"), which is what the optimize skill and req:time-and-tokens-are-measured-per-task-against-budgets already ask for. Cheap, and it carries the constants Big O hides.
(d) flo2-calc WORKS IT OUT: given a recurrence or the costs of the steps a part calls, calc solves or composes the bound (master theorem, loops multiply, sequences add) and keeps the record, so a claim like (a) has a cited derivation (see flo2-calc's idea linked here).
(e) COSTS COMPOSE ALONG THE DESIGN: a capability's growth is derived from the components it DEPENDS_ON, so making one part O(n²) shows in the blast radius of everything above it. Largest: new derived reading in the engine.
(f) NOT ONLY TIME: memory, reply size and tokens grow too. This week's failures were mostly OUTPUT growing with n and no bound: list_my_design_files, search_my_design_files, propagate_change, loop_status (#197, #198 and the A-E PR). "Every reply is bounded by its budget, never O(n)" is a Big O statement about replies.
(g) LEAVE IT TO THE AGENT: complexity is domain knowledge a software agent brings; reflow2 designs anything and should not special-case software.

Counter-arguments, kept beside the idea rather than against it:
- Big O hides the constant and the size where it bites. This week's slowness was mostly constants and cliffs, not classes: a full-text commit per write made fixtures ~200x slower at the same O(n) (fact:a-test-writing-a-large-design-outside-a-write-unit-runs-200x-slower-where-full-text-is-on-2026-10-26); a recursive walk overflowed the stack (a depth limit, not a growth rate); loop_status took 52 s at 2,000 steps and 125 s at 3,000, a growth of about n² that nobody had declared. (b) and (c) catch these; (a) alone would not have.
- A declared class with no check is a claim, not a measurement, which reflow2 otherwise refuses to treat as true; (a) without (b) adds a field that drifts silently from the code.
- Cost: (a) and (c) are small; (b) is moderate; (d) and (e) are large and research-shaped, and (d) is only as good as the per-step costs an agent states.
- "Design anything": the same idea exists outside software (the square-cube law in physical design: weight grows with size cubed while strength grows with its square), so a general "how does this scale with size" record could serve both, not a software-only field.
properties.name: SETTLED 2026-10-27 — growth is kept honest by measuring it: replies never grow with the design (f), and a part's growth is counted at several sizes and budgeted at its real size (b)+(c); a declared class alone (a), calc-derived bounds (d), composed growth (e) and leaving it to the agent (g) stay considered
properties.rationale: Asked in the session that, the same day, root-caused four replies that grew with the design and had no bound, and measured a status read growing roughly with n². Recorded as an open question with its options; nothing is built or researched until Anthony says which to keep. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
